ai_summary: Alembic Pharmaceuticals Limited has secured final USFDA approval for its generic Olopatadine Hydrochloride Ophthalmic Solution USP, 0.7% (OTC), enabling its entry into the U.S. market for this eye allergy relief product. This approval opens a new revenue stream within an estimated US$20 million annual market, positively expanding Alembic's extensive portfolio of generic drugs and reinforcing its market presence without any apparent red flags.
